brief: The enormous popularity of Christopher as the patron saint of travellers has if anything increased as travel has become more common. This is so, despite the fact that nothing is known about Christopher except the fact of his death in Asia Minor during the third century. There are many legends about him, the best loved being the story of how he carried a child across a river, and was almost bowed under by the weight. Asking about this, he learned that he had carried the Christ child and the world he had made.
